details.Title paint: your Pulse panel title painted in a Glass, Etched or Halo finish, with the wave and sheen you pick.
details.Tenure crest: a crest beside your painted title that levels up at 3, 6, 12 and 24 months of support.
details.Emote rain: 7TV emotes behind your Pulse panel header, still or falling: the 7TV header backdrop.
details.Supporter card: your own crest and paint on the Supporter card in quick settings and in settings, as private recognition for supporting.

onlyYou: Only you see them, in your own StreamPulse extension. Nothing is added to chat, and nobody else sees them.
moved: Emote rain, the 7TV header backdrop, was free up to extension 0.2.1. From 0.2.2 it is a Supporter perk, and a backdrop you saved is kept for when you support. No other free feature moved behind Supporter.

seenInChat.name: Seen in chat
seenInChat.detail: optional: your crest beside your name and your paint on it in Twitch chat, for other StreamPulse viewers. Off until you turn it on.
seenInChat.onlyYou: Title paint, emote rain and the Supporter card show only in your own StreamPulse extension. Seen in chat is the one exception, and only if you turn it on: then other StreamPulse viewers see your crest and paint in chat. People without StreamPulse always see normal Twitch chat.
